# Test fixtures

**Synthetic** HTML/JSON written by hand to mimic the structure of real SEC filings
(inline XBRL header, table of contents, layout tables, split `$` / `)` cells, page footers).
Numbers and text are invented: do not use them as facts.

Real-filing snippets will be added once real filings have been downloaded and quirks observed;
each new quirk found in real data should get a minimal fixture + regression test here.
